name: Ochiru Part Tsuma - Toshishita Otoko to no Jouji ni Oboreta Hate ni...
original_name: 堕ちるパート妻 年下男との情事に溺れた果てに…
source:
Sunao Saiki, driven by a heartbreak and a failed exam due to a nasty breakup, decides it's time for a change and hits the road. At his part-time gig in a restaurant, he crosses paths with Ayano Shinonome, an older woman oozing kindness and a mature allure. Turns out, they're neighbors in the same apartment complex. Despite being married, Ayano and Sunao's connection deepens. But things take a twist when Sunao finds out that Ayano's first love was his uncle – who happens to bear an uncanny resemblance to him. As his feelings of admiration and envy spiral out of control, he craves an even more profound bond with her.
As Ayano confronts memories of her youthful first loves and embraces Sunao's unfiltered emotions, her heart becomes entangled between her lackluster married life with her careless husband...

[From F95zone]
translation:
一場不愉快的分手，讓西木砂生既失戀，又考試落榜。他決定改變現狀，離家另尋出路。在餐廳打工時，他結識了東雲綾乃，一位溫柔又充滿成熟魅力的年長女性。原來，兩人還是同一棟公寓裡的鄰居。儘管綾乃已婚，她與砂生的關係仍逐漸加深。然而，砂生發現，綾乃的初戀竟是自己的叔叔，而且那人與自己長得驚人地相似。隨著仰慕與嫉妒愈發失控，他渴望與她發展更深的關係。
當綾乃面對年輕時初戀的回憶，接受砂生毫無保留的情感時，她的心也在這份感情，與粗心丈夫所帶來的乏味婚姻之間糾結……

[摘自F95zone]
